meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 让代理能接入 GitHub 评论：把适配器复制进项目、注册频道并完成构建与测试。之后代理会在 PR/issue 评论里用机器人账号回复：被 @ 时响应，首次 @ 后订阅该线程并跟进后续评论，且忽略机器人自己的留言。
howto.when: 当你提出要接入 GitHub、让机器人参与 PR 或 issue 评论时触发；需要提供仓库地址和专用机器人账号。

say.text: 帮我接入 GitHub，让机器人回复 PR 和 issue 评论
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册频道并跑构建。

say.text: 仓库是公开的，用 strict 模式接入
say.note: 需先把允许触发的人加为成员。

say.text: 帮我检查 GitHub 适配器是否注册成功
say.note: 会运行注册测试并反馈结果。

howto.what_en: Adds GitHub channel support. The agent replies in PR/issue comment threads when @-mentioned, then follows the thread and ignores its own bot comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add GitHub integration, e.g. having the bot respond to PR or issue comments. Requires a repo address and a dedicated bot account.

say_en.text: Set up GitHub so the bot can reply to PR and issue comments.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter, registering, and building.

say_en.text: This repo is public; onboard it in strict mode.
say_en.note: Trusted members must be added before use.

say_en.text: Check whether the GitHub adapter is registered.
say_en.note: Runs the registration test and reports the result.
